news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Shares Down 2.6% Ahead of Q2 Earnings
news.summary: CLPT shares slipped to around $14.12 on below-average volume (about 467,000 shares) in the final trading days before the August 3 Q2 2026 earnings release, continuing the drift lower from the mid-June FDA-driven highs.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Results August 3, 2026
news.summary: ClearPoint Neuro confirmed it will report Q2 2026 financial results after market close on August 3, 2026, with a conference call the same afternoon.

news.headline: Weiss Ratings Reiterates 'Sell (D-)' on ClearPoint Neuro
news.summary: Independent rating firm Weiss Ratings restated a bearish 'Sell (D-)' rating on CLPT shares, contrasting with more bullish sell-side analyst targets from firms like B. Riley.

news.headline: EpilepsyGTx Partners with ClearPoint Neuro to Support Targeted Delivery of Lead Gene Therapy in Epilepsy
news.summary: EpilepsyGTx will use ClearPoint's SmartFlow Cannula and Neuro Navigation System to deliver its investigational gene therapy EPY201 in an upcoming first-in-human Phase I/IIa trial for focal refractory epilepsy, adding another biopharma partner to ClearPoint's platform.

news.headline: B. Riley Raises ClearPoint Neuro Price Target to $30 from $20, Buy Rating
news.summary: Analyst Anderson Schock lifted his price target to $30 and reiterated a Buy rating following the favorable FDA update on partner uniQure's AMT-130 program, citing ClearPoint's base business of 60+ biopharma partnerships and expedited-review intracranial programs.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Shares Jump as FDA Progress for uniQure's AMT-130 Highlights Platform Value
news.summary: uniQure disclosed that the FDA agreed 3-year Phase I/II data can support an accelerated-approval BLA for AMT-130 (Huntington's disease gene therapy delivered via ClearPoint's navigation system and SmartFlow cannula), sending CLPT shares up roughly 26-32% intraday as the reversal revived confidence in ClearPoint's gene-therapy delivery franchise.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint Neuro reports Q2 2026 results after market close with a conference call at 4:30pm ET the same day; investors will watch organic device growth, IRRAflow/IRRAS integration progress, and margin/cash-burn trends versus reaffirmed FY2026 guidance.

catalysts.label: uniQure AMT-130 BLA submission
catalysts.detail: Partner uniQure plans to submit its Biologics License Application for AMT-130 (Huntington's disease gene therapy delivered via ClearPoint's SmartFlow cannula and Neuro Navigation System) for accelerated approval, a key validation event for ClearPoint's drug-delivery platform.

catalysts.label: EpilepsyGTx first-in-human EPY201 trial start
catalysts.detail: EpilepsyGTx plans to begin a Phase I/IIa trial of its gene therapy EPY201 for focal refractory epilepsy using ClearPoint's delivery platform, expanding ClearPoint's partnered pipeline into a new indication.

catalysts.label: Full-year revenue guidance of $52M-$56M
catalysts.detail: Management has reaffirmed full-year 2026 revenue guidance of $52-56 million; continued acceleration through H2 2026, aided by new partner programs and IRRAflow, is a key event investors are tracking toward.

catalysts.label: CE Mark decision for ClearPoint Prism Laser Therapy system
catalysts.detail: Partner Clinical Laserthermia Systems (CLS) filed a CE-marking application in Europe for the ClearPoint Prism Neuro Laser Therapy System (1.5T and 3.0T MRI guidance) in December 2025; regulatory approval is expected in the second half of 2026, which would enable commercial launch in European hospitals.

pulse: CLPT has been highly volatile over the past six weeks, driven mainly by a partner-program catalyst: the June 17 FDA agreement allowing uniQure to pursue accelerated approval for AMT-130 (delivered via ClearPoint's platform) sent shares up 26-32% intraday and triggered a B. Riley price-target hike to $30, but the stock has since given back essentially all of that spike, drifting from the high-teens/low-$20s in mid-June down to around $14 by late July amid a mixed analyst picture (Weiss Ratings still rates it Sell as of July 17; sell-side consensus otherwise ranges from Hold to Buy with targets around $16-$30). The company added another gene-therapy partner (EpilepsyGTx) on July 14, and shares drifted further to about $14.12 on July 25 on thin volume ahead of the next major near-term test: the Q2 2026 earnings report on August 3, 2026, which will show whether commercial execution and the reaffirmed $52-56M FY2026 revenue guidance can justify the platform's partnership-driven bull case.
